intro: Most people check a trainer online before they ever reach out. Here is the updated website for {{BUSINESS}}, built around your story, your programs and your photos. Scroll to see the full page.

changes.title: Your story up front.
changes.text: Move toward discipline, better health and better lives, backed by your 11 years in the Air Force, ISSA certification, Hyrox and marathons.

changes.title: Programs that commit.
changes.text: 3, 6 and 9 month programs plus custom workout plans, with pricing handled on a free consult.

changes.title: Booking in one tap.
changes.text: Every button leads to a free consult, and a Book a free consult bar stays on every phone screen.
